title: Build the stage-skill generator and its check mode
statement: Generate one packaged skill per canonical stage definition, named `kiln-stage-<stage-id>` at `pi-package/skills/kiln-stage-<stage-id>/SKILL.md`, carrying the stage's purpose, decision owner, outputs and exit criteria exactly as `stages/*.json` declares them, with deterministic generated-file metadata; and a `--check` mode that writes nothing and fails, naming each stale, missing or orphaned skill. Method, next-activity selection, allowed delegations, mutation and approval boundaries and the completion summary are NOT generated here, because no canonical definition carries them yet: TSK-0071 adds them to the definitions first.
notes: ⚠️ NARROWED 2026-09-13 (O1). The original statement promised ten things and the canonical definitions support four. The six without a source moved to TSK-0071, which adds them to `stages/*.json` before anything generates them, so this task never has to invent methodology in a template.
